name: Prompt Cache Anchor
description: Appends a stable, byte-identical anchor comment to the system prompt to maximize Anthropic automatic prefix-cache hits.

anchor.description: The anchor string to append (must be stable across turns)

cacheHint.description: Desired cache TTL hint appended as a comment. '5m' = default Anthropic prefix-cache; '1h' = 1-hour TTL (requires provider support). Changing this value will invalidate existing cache hits (default: '5m')
